result.summary: The interface is functional but exhibits signs of being an unfinished or staging build due to placeholder assets and minor styling inconsistencies.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used as placeholders throughout the app instead of actual food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace these graphics with authentic, high-quality images of real dishes from the respective restaurants.

issues.description: Low visual contrast between light-colored card backgrounds and the main page background makes container boundaries difficult to distinguish.
issues.suggestion: Apply a subtle border or soft drop shadow to improve card definition against the white background.
